findings.evidence: "SELECT id, total FROM invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,)
findings.reason: The invoice lookup is keyed only by invoice_id and does not include an authenticated tenant or organization boundary.
The caller-supplied path is used as the filesystem destination without resolving it and verifying that it remains inside an allowed storage root.
The remote dependency call has no end-to-end deadline or propagated cancellation timeout, directly repeating the supplied scar.
